title: indigo_uni_io never releases TIOCEXCL, so a Linux pseudo-terminal refuses every reopen with EBUSY
description:
indigo_uni_io opens serial ports with TIOCEXCL and closed them without TIOCNXCL. On Linux a pseudo-terminal slave keeps the exclusive flag after its last descriptor is closed while the master stays open, so the second open of a serial simulator port failed with 'Device or resource busy'. Every reconnect in a Linux simulator run failed: 9 of 54 focuser_primaluce cases and test_focuser_primaluce_motion. A failed open after a successful TIOCEXCL (tcsetattr error) left the port claimed the same way. Real serial ports are released when the tty is freed (the Linux arm64 hardware run of focuser_primaluce reconnects).

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-000049.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
